blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Ничего, если я ___ (заночевать) в доме у друга?
exercises.prompt: Is it okay if I spend the night over at a friend's house?
exercises.why: **заночевать → заночую** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Let's mingle with the crowd.
exercises.why: **смешаться → смешаемся** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.

exercises.prompt: Cool your burnt fingers under running water.
exercises.why: **охладить → Охладите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: One crow doesn't peck another's eye.
exercises.why: **выклевать → выклюет** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I'll put it on the list.
exercises.why: **включить → включу** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Я ___ (наносить) немного противовоспалительного крема на правое колено.
exercises.prompt: I'm pouring some anti-inflammatory cream on my right knee.
exercises.why: **наносить → наношу** — present-type form, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: I'll be disappointed if you don't come.
exercises.why: **огорчиться → огорчусь** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Скоро ___ (наступить) новый год по григорианскому календарю.
exercises.prompt: A new year of the Gregorian calendar will soon begin.
exercises.why: **наступить → наступит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I hope I don't botch the job.
exercises.why: **запороть → запорю** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Break the chocolate into smaller pieces.
exercises.why: **покрошить → Покрошите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: May they rest in peace.
exercises.why: **упокоиться → упокоятся** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Если беспокоишься, пусть тебя ___ (проверить) на эндоскопии.
exercises.prompt: If you're worried, go for an endoscopy to have it checked out.
exercises.why: **проверить → проверят** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: How long is it going to last? About one or two weeks.
exercises.why: **продлиться → продлится** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Время, которое вы ___ (посвятить) изучению латыни, всегда будет плодотворным.
exercises.prompt: The time you dedicate to the study of Latin will always be fruitful.
exercises.why: **посвятить → посвятите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Let's just take a break.
exercises.why: **взять → возьмём** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.

exercises.prompt: Let's sit over there.
exercises.why: **сесть → сядем** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.

exercises.prompt: No one will notice the substitution.
exercises.why: **заметить → заметит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I hope nothing goes wrong.
exercises.why: **сорваться → сорвётся** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: You'll soon get used to driving on the right.
exercises.why: **привыкнуть → привыкнете** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: We will exempt you from attending.
exercises.why: **освободить → освободим** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
